preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised the owner's private key)

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the setBlacklist() function to blacklist any target address (e.g., a competing contract or user). This will prevent the blacklisted address from making any transfers, effectively freezing their tokens. The exploit demonstrates unauthorized privilege escalation where the owner can arbitrarily stop contracts/addresses from transacting.
